text:
42
a set of Kew's Ceylon species
A good many had been sent to
Kew to be named with a very
bad result. Kew has sent also
a very large proportion of the Roglean
distribution, including species not
in Herb. Hook
There are several Nepal species
new to me, evidently from Lambe's
Herbarium, which contained many
of Bud. Hametts plants -- They are
not in a state fit for description.
Is it known where Lambe's
Herbarium is? Most of it
went abroad.
There is a beautiful small species
